verdict.rationale: Dedicated, autoscaled capacity is a fair axis for an inference provider like Groq. The evidence pack only documents shared service tiers (on-demand, flex, auto) and asynchronous batch processing. These are adjacent throughput and latency options, not dedicated, isolated deployments with autoscaling, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can deploy a model on dedicated GPU capacity with autoscaling so my traffic is isolated from the shared serverless pool
